purpose: Select one globally shared new candidate for paired bootstrap against the previously fixed six-dataset comboF baseline
criterion: Maximum clean CLC_tune native AP; no test values enter ranking
within_batch_parameters: Use only A global selected weights, B source-stress selected r4, and C shared selected tau. No diagnostic beta roles or per-dataset choices enter pool.
baseline: Previous uniform comboF (etaF=.75, alpha=.5, Gaussian sigma=1) on each fixed full test cohort
test_exposure: Exploratory: previous and A test results known; B/C controllers already finished but root has not inspected their numerical test results. This rule is not prospective blinded preregistration.
candidate_bootstrap: All six tests use the same selected candidate. Paired B2000 immutable old image draws; report B1000 sensitivity and all signs, with no threshold/sign-based reselection.
